Physical published-model camera campaign, audit1890

Generation only reads local inventory and hashes files. Every case starts
not_run. This procedure is for a reserved Linux target with two identified
physical cameras and a consenting participant. It does not measure general
model accuracy or prove the example application's V4L2 sample-ID join.

1. Qualify the target before executing any generated command. The inventory
   must bind CLI and installed Agent SHA256 to a reproducible candidate build,
   machine-id, hardware serial, OS/kernel, camera USB serial/topology and exact
   returned V4L2 source IDs. On its console compare /etc/machine-id, uname -a,
   systemctl show wendy-agent.service -p MainPID -p ExecStart, and sha256sum
   /proc/PID/exe to the inventory. Capture PID birth time and boot_id. This
   procedure does not install/update an Agent or change enrollment. Resolve
   mismatches before continuing. Have the owner's working recovery image and
   console access; stop if the candidate cannot be restored safely.

   Record authorization for this bounded capture, camera unplug/replug and one
   Agent restart. Keep other people and private material outside the scene.
   Provision only the generated @PLAN@/cli-profile with the operator's
   authorized credentials for this target. The commands pin that profile and
   use its private file secret store. Do not copy credentials into the evidence.
   The records.scene_protocol file must define camera placement/lighting,
   the empty scene, a consenting person's marked standing region and timed
   entry/exit sequence, plus the observer who labels those intervals.

2. Compare candidate/CLI hashes again. Run these bounded commands, preserving
   stdout, stderr and shell exit status. A timeout or nonzero status fails the
   phase. Rename each observation before repeating it so earlier evidence is
   not overwritten. No host/target is selected implicitly.

   @INFO@
   @SOURCES@
   @LIST@
   @STATUS@

   Require the inventoried device and cameras and no preexisting campaigns or
   recording. Disconnect only camera B, identified by its serial and USB port;
   re-run sources and confirm A remains. Inventory IDs are observations, not
   a claim that /dev/video numbers survive a reconnect.

3. The model manifest must come from an independently reviewed download of
   facebook/detr-resnet-50 commit1d5f47bd3bdd2c4bbfa585418ffe6da5028b4c0b,
   including config/processor and safetensors hashes. Verify the Agent's actual
   snapshot files against it after loading. Never substitute locally fitted
   weights, a branch name, pickle weights or supplied predictions. Record the
   candidate's managed Python and locked dependency versions, model snapshot
   location and available RAM/storage. Allow at most15minutes for initial
   loading and5minutes for each later phase; expiry is failed/inconclusive,
   never a pass. Runtime/model caches are retained after this rehearsal.

   @DEPLOY@
   @INSPECT@

   Poll inspect every5seconds within that deadline. Require the exact model,
   revision, CPU accelerator, running inference_status, A in its sources and
   advancing inference stats. Deploy success alone does not establish capture.
   The generated plan keeps uploads manual and has no notification policy.
   Do not manually trigger an episode: detection must cause it.

4. With A's scene empty for30seconds, no owned detection episode may start.
   The observer records wall time and target boot time when the consenting
   person enters the marked region. Keep the person visible for45seconds.
   Require an event:person_detected episode and no repeated episode while the
   person remains present. Leave the scene empty for10seconds, and wait until
   at least30seconds have elapsed since the last detection before re-entering.
   Require a new episode. Failure to detect this qualified scene is a failed
   physical acceptance, not evidence that a synthetic model test sufficed.

   @EPISODES@
   @STATUS@

   Select IDs only by trigger.campaign_name=@NAME@ and the recorded phase.
   For each selected ID run the actual commands below, replacing EPISODE_ID
   and NEW_DIRECTORY with that owned ID and a fresh path under this plan.
   Bound each command with the same guardian shown above, at120seconds.

       @CLI@ --json --device @ENDPOINT@ data inspect EPISODE_ID
       @CLI@ --json --device @ENDPOINT@ data download EPISODE_ID --output NEW_DIRECTORY

   Inspect must return exit0 with verified checksums and state complete.
   Retain manifest.json, events.jsonl, model_inputs.jsonl and camera payloads.
   Independently decode the recorded camera media with the inventoried
   decoder and compare it to the observer's scene timeline. Require actual
   person detections, configured model revision in model_versions, positive
   model_io prediction/input-delivery counts, correct source IDs and positive
   frame dimensions. Report unknown input_reference_status honestly: this
   managed opaque-video decoder does not provide exact per-prediction sample
   joins. Missing or fabricated sample references are not acceptable proof.

5. Keep the person visible on A. Unplug A for10seconds, reconnect its exact
   serial/port, then within5minutes require resumed frames/new source stream
   and no duplicate appearance episode caused only by the outage. An outage
   is not an empty-scene observation. Keep all evidence from that interval.
   Now attach B. Within5minutes require B to join inference_status.sources.
   Give B an empty10second interval then the same marked person challenge.
   Require B's own detection and recorded bytes. An already open episode may
   retain its original source set; repeat after it seals before judging B.

6. Leave both scenes empty and wait for all owned captures to seal. Save
   inspect, sources and process observations. On the reserved target console
   execute exactly `sudo systemctl restart wendy-agent.service`. Confirm a
   new Agent PID/birth time, unchanged binary hash and same boot_id. Do not
   redeploy the plan. Within5minutes require the persisted campaign and both
   physical sources to resume; repeat the empty/person challenge and inspect
   the new complete episode. A fresh deploy is not restart-persistence proof.

7. @DISARM@
   Poll inspect until state and inference_status report disarmed. Wait for
   any owned episode to seal naturally. Compare lsof/process observations
   against the pretrial idle baseline: no campaign model worker or camera
   descriptor may remain owned solely by this campaign. Shared platform
   services can remain; do not kill them. Then execute:
   @REMOVE@
   @LIST@
   Require the exact owned campaign absent. Episodes and model/runtime caches
   remain for review; do not use data stop, data delete --all or purge caches.
   Restore camera cabling and the owner's original idle Agent state. Record
   cleanup failures explicitly. Do not remove unrelated files or processes.

Regression sensitivity and limits

The existing generated-scene runtime gate independently rejects restoring
lost-presence and omitted-model-input-ledger behavior. Its controls must pass
their intended failure boundaries before claiming regression coverage; they
do not establish physical capture or published-model acceptance. This human
run adds those observations using unchanged candidate code. Historical
sample-ID timestamp behavior belongs to the separate example-app/kernel
join case and remains pending until actually exercised. No GPU, radio,
deployed Cloud or general detection-accuracy claim follows from this result.
